amount.description:
Transfer amount as an integer amount in cents
"$10.00" is `1000`.
Only currency in USD is supported.

ach.description: ACH object is only required if the origination or destination account is an External account

class_code.description:
ACH Standard Entry Class (SEC) code. Supported SEC codes are:

CCD - Cash Concentration or Disbursement,
PPD - Prearranged Payment and Deposit,
WEB - Internet-Initiated Entry.

Conditionally required for ACH transfers.

same_day.description:
ACH transfer network, false = standard 
true = same-day-ach.
